scope: Independent full-grid audit of online records, protocol-matched training and saved base Q-table canonical hashes. Initial aggregate hashes recomputed as60identicaldevicecopies.
limitations: Online final per-device Q arrays are not persisted in NPZ; their final aggregate hash is consistency-checked but not independently recomputed from disk. Selected deterministic replay is a separate parent validation.
Protocol-matched online training intentionally produces different initial tables across conditions; this evaluates end-to-end deployments, not format-only inference effects.
Original SNR-dependent reward is not run online with compact feedback; only energy-reward learner variants are eligible.
No claim of ns-3 or hardware validation.
